terms.comment: The month adjective alone also serves: Jūniō, Augustō, Septembrī, Octōbrī.

phrases.english: Strawberries in June, in the woods.

phrases.latin: Nūllum jam in arbore mālum pendēbat; quae Octōbrī lēcta erant, in cellā jacēbant
phrases.english: There were no apples left on the tree; the ones picked in October lay in the storeroom

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 347.
